name: The Road of a Dark Mage
source:
A Visual Novel based on the story of Eva from Negima. It features her past as a vampire and her struggle to survive in both the old world and the magic world, in order to take her revenge upon the one who turned her into a vampire. It takes place from her 10th birthday until her entrance into Mahora. Learn the unoffical story of her tragic life on the path to becoming the most powerful dark mage in history.

[From [url=http://twilightdreamsscans.darkbb.com/twilight-dreams-productions-f33/the-road-of-a-dark-mage-t270.htm]The Official Site[/url]]
